answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to carry a verifiable work history, like rings in timber: each completed job leaves a signed, timestamped record, and a cipher-based attestation chain links each new act to the ones before it. Spinning up a fresh identity is cheap, but fabricating a deep, consistent history is not. An agent with no provenance stands out the way a karst sinkhole stands out in solid ground — the absence of solid footing gives it away.
